h1: CSM tube benders — all-electric, electric-hybrid and hydraulic CNC, NC and symmetric benders, Ø15/32″ to Ø8-5/8″
intro: A CNC tube bender feeds, rotates and bends the tube from a program, so a part with ten bends in different planes comes off the machine the same every time; a mandrel inside the tube and a wiper die keep thin walls round at tight radii. CSM — Chiao Sheng Machinery of Tainan, Taiwan — has built tube benders since 1982 and CNC benders since 1989, holds 24 international design patents and CE-certifies every machine. The range on this page, small to large: the EMB / EMR all-electric benders that switch between left- and right-hand bending within one part, from Ø19/32″ brake and fuel line to Ø3″, and the all-electric MRE2-RBE to Ø4″; the MBE / MRE and TBRE / TMRE / TSRE / TDRE electric hybrids — servo bend arm, carriage and collet, hydraulic clamp and mandrel — from Ø15/32″ to Ø6″ with one to three stacked tools and roll-bending heads; the TSR / TDR hydraulic CNC pipe benders to Ø8-5/8″; the TSRJ / TDRJ, TNCPB and TNCB NC hydraulic benders; and the two-head F38 / F50 symmetric benders. Rear boosters, loaders, punching units, saws, end formers and robot cells turn any of them into an automated bending cell. Sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech from Mississauga, ON, with a CSA-approved panel.

faq.a: All-electric (EMB / EMR, MRE2-RBE): every axis is a servo motor — no oil, no warm-up, lower energy use, quiet and the most repeatable; the choice for small tube in high volume — fuel and brake lines, HVAC, head-rest bars, furniture. Electric hybrid (MBE / MRE and the T series): servo bend arm, carriage and collet for accuracy, hydraulic clamp, pressure die and mandrel for force — the usual production bender from Ø1/2″ to Ø6″. Hydraulic CNC (TSR / TDR): a hydraulic bend arm for heavy wall and large pipe to Ø8-5/8″ — boiler, shipyard, construction and water-supply pipe. NC (TSRJ / TDRJ, TNCPB, TNCB): PLC control and a lower price where the parts are simpler or the batches smaller.

faq.q: How do I read a CSM model name?
faq.a: The number is the largest round tube in millimetres: a 38 TDRE bends Ø1-1/2″ (38.1 mm), an 80 MBE Ø3-1/8″ (80 mm), a 220 TNCB Ø8-5/8″ pipe. The letters name the series — EMB / EMR all-electric, MBE / MRE and the TBRE / TMRE / TSRE / TDRE electric hybrids, TSR / TDR hydraulic CNC, TSRJ / TDRJ, TNCPB and TNCB NC — and in the T series S, D and M stand for one, two and three stacked tools. The suffix names the booster: -RBE a servo rear booster, -RBF, -RBH and -CBF hydraulic boosters.

faq.q: How many stacked tools do I need, and what is roll bending?
faq.a: Each stacked tool is another bend die (radius) on the same head; the head shifts up / down and left / right between them, so a part with two or three radii is bent in one cycle without a die change. One tool (TSRE, TSR, TNCB) suits single-radius parts; two (TDRE, TDR, TBRE) or three (MBE / MRE, TMRE) furniture, automotive and exhaust parts with several radii; the EMB / EMR carry 3 + 3, for left- and right-hand bends. A roll-bending head (EMR, MRE, TBRE / TMRE, MRE2-RBE) rolls large and variable radii — arcs, coils and frames — without a die for every radius.

faq.q: What does a rear booster do?
faq.a: It pushes the tube from behind while the bend arm draws it around the die, so the outside wall thins less and the inside wall does not wrinkle — the way to bend thin-wall tube and pipe to radii down to about 1 × D (boiler pipe on the 120 TNCB-RBF, for example). -RBE is a servo booster on the electric and hybrid benders; -RBF, -RBH and -CBF are hydraulic boosters on the hydraulic machines.

Yes: bundle loaders that feed the tube to the carriage, punching units on the head for holes in furniture tube (the P versions), an integrated circular saw that cuts each part off the bar, end-forming stations, robot transfer and checking fixtures. The videos under each series show most of them in production, and we lay out the cell for your parts.

Both are mandrel benders sold, installed and supported by NovoTech. The ISITAN SFB benders (Turkey) cover Ø1-1/4″ to Ø3-1/2″ with NC and CNC models for the job shop and fabricator. CSM covers a far wider range — from Ø15/32″ brake line to Ø8-5/8″ pipe — with all-electric and hybrid machines, stacked tools, boosters and automation for series production. Send us the part drawing and the tube and we quote the right machine from either range; the capacity table for every bender is on the pipe and tube benders overview.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
